title: Introducing ChatGPT for Excel and new financial data integrations
summary: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Excel and new financial app integrations, powered by GPT-5.4 to accelerate modeling, research, and analysis in regulated environments.
body: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Excel and new financial app integrations, powered by GPT-5.4 to accelerate modeling, research, and analysis in regulated environments.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了ChatGPT for Excel及金融数据集成功能，由GPT-5.4驱动。该集成旨在加速金融建模、数据研究与分析流程，特别适用于受监管的专业环境，提升了办公自动化效率。原始信息显示：OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Excel and new financial app integrations, powered by GPT-5.4 to accelerate modeling, research, and analysis in regulated environments.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing ChatGPT for Excel and new financial data integrations”。其重要性主要体现在：GPT-5.4在金融办公场景的落地应用，展示了模型在专业工具集成中的实际价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
